html:
A naval expedition sent by Kublai Khan's Yuan dynasty against Java in 1293. It ended in failure for the Mongols and, by a twist, in the founding of Majapahit, the greatest of the Javanese kingdoms.

The quarrel began when Kertanegara, king of Singhasari, refused to submit and sent back a Yuan envoy with his face marked. Kublai sent a fleet of some 20,000 to 30,000 soldiers. By the time it landed, Kertanegara was dead, killed in a revolt by Jayakatwang of Kediri.

Kertanegara's son in law, Raden Wijaya, offered to submit to the Mongols if they helped him beat Jayakatwang. Together they took Kediri. Then Wijaya turned on his allies, attacked them as they returned to their ships, and drove them out of Java. He founded Majapahit the same year. Like the invasions of Japan, the expedition showed the limits of Mongol power at sea.
